title: Why Do We Forget?
subtitle: 考点：记忆规律 / memorize, recall, go through
passage: Everyone forgets things. You may learn a new word in the morning and forget it by night. Scientists say that we forget quickly at first, and then more slowly. If you do not go through new information again, you may lose most of it within a few days.

However, there are ways to remember better. First, review what you learn soon after class. Then review it again after one day, one week and one month. Second, link new facts with things you already know. Third, try to recall the information without looking at the book. This is more effective than reading it again and again. A good memory is not a gift. It is a skill, and you can build it up.
